patch_description: Building on the seed's alternating single-qubit rotation + entangling-CZ pattern, this version replaces the fixed (non-parametrized) CZ entangling layer with trainable CRZ gates arranged in a nearest-neighbor ring, and adds a second, sparser "skip-2" entangling layer whose CRZ parameters are all tied together (single shared parameter). This gives the circuit tunable entanglement strength (addressing the recommendation to swap fixed CZ for parametrized CRZ) while keeping the parameter count essentially unchanged versus the seed. The skip-2 connectivity (qubit i entangled with i+2 mod 8) creates longer-range correlations that a purely nearest-neighbor chain cannot capture, which should improve expressivity/accuracy, while the shared parameter on that layer acts as an implicit regularizer to curb overfitting and shrink the train/validation gap. An RX layer is inserted between the two entangling layers so that the two rotation axes (RY then RX) together with the ring CRZ realize an effectively richer single-qubit rotation before the long-range mixing, without needing three separate RZ layers as in the seed.
